latest_release.name: v0.16.0
latest_release.body:
Completes support for all TMX format changes up to Tiled 1.12, including the oblique orientation, list properties, layer blend modes, capsule objects and various older attributes that were still missing. Also switches the XML parser to `quick-xml` for a significant speedup, and raises the Rust edition to 2024 (MSRV 1.85).

Note for contributors: the repository has moved to a single-branch workflow; development now happens on `main`, and the `current`/`next` branches are gone.

## What's Changed
* Switch from xml-rs to quick-xml by @bjorn in https://github.com/mapeditor/rs-tiled/pull/334
* Add oblique orientation and related map properties by @bjorn in https://github.com/mapeditor/rs-tiled/pull/335
* Add support for list properties by @tesselode, @AwfulToTheEar and @bjorn in https://github.com/mapeditor/rs-tiled/pull/341
* Add tileset tile render size, fill mode and object alignment by @bjorn in https://github.com/mapeditor/rs-tiled/pull/342
* Add layer blend mode, capsule shape and object opacity by @bjorn in https://github.com/mapeditor/rs-tiled/pull/343
* Add remaining pre-1.12 TMX format attributes by @bjorn in https://github.com/mapeditor/rs-tiled/pull/344
* Unify user_type fields on a plain String by @bjorn in https://github.com/mapeditor/rs-tiled/pull/345
* Deprecate the values of ObjectShape::Point by @bjorn in https://github.com/mapeditor/rs-tiled/pull/346
* Raise edition to 2024 and fix clippy lints by @bjorn in https://github.com/mapeditor/rs-tiled/pull/347
* Merge next to current for the switch to a single-branch workflow by @bjorn in https://github.com/mapeditor/rs-tiled/pull/348
* Prepare for v0.16.0 by @bjorn in https://github.com/mapeditor/rs-tiled/pull/349


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/mapeditor/rs-tiled/compare/v0.15.1...v0.16.0
